_comment: Copy to <repo>/local/sites.json (untracked) and fill in real values. Tests that need it skip when it is absent.

site1.formatted: Census-style upper-case one-line address that geocode.geocode() should return
site1.footprint_id: Building outline id the county layer returns for this address
site1.parcel_id: Parcel id (AIN) of this address in parcels_site1_60m.geojson

_keys.origin: SW corner of the footprint bbox, as written in the truth fixture
_keys.geocode_point: Exact coordinates the recorded Census response contains (census_site1.json)
_keys.lidar_box_center: Centre of the 20 m LiDAR box used by the live network test
_keys.parcel_tests.near_neighbor_point: A point in front of the neighbour, nearest to a different parcel than the target
_keys.parcel_tests.neighbor_line1: Address of the neighbouring parcel (house number 104) that must resolve to its own parcel
_keys.parcel_tests.missing_line1: Address with a house number that exists on no parcel (999), expected to fall back to nearest
_keys.parcel_tests.truth_point: Truth-fixture origin, used as the query point for footprint selection
